contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing dating to the Roman period. The seal is rectangular in plan and in section. The obverse is struck with the legend 'BFC' ' ​b(ene)f(iciarius) c(onsularis) ​I ? ​ex(pedivit) 'The benificiarius consularis has despatched this' within a rectangular die.
